limitations: Equal-weight averages of monthly medians are not annual medians.
Omitted-month and cutoff results are sensitivity checks, not confidence intervals.
Daily correlations are pairwise descriptive statistics, not conventional full-series ACF or forecasts.
Month centering does not establish stationarity.
No instrument calibration uncertainty inferred from quality codes.
Median bounds address missing data only; no measurement-error allowance.
Cabauw raw daily records not processed; comparisons use existing nominal surface summaries.
No wind, vertical profile model, flight model, or trajectory analysis.
